summary.headline: Campus Activewear Q2 FY27 revenue rose 16.9% YoY to Rs 452 crore on 10.2% volume growth, while EBITDA margin fell to 13.5%; FY27 17% EBITDA margin guided.
summary.overview: Revenue grew 16.9% YoY to Rs 452 crore on 10.2% volume growth to 6.3 million pairs and 6% ASP improvement. EBITDA rose 12.5% to Rs 62 crore but margin slipped about 50 bps to 13.5%, with gross margin at 51.4% versus 53.9% a year earlier due to material inflation. PAT grew 21.3% to Rs 24 crore (5.3% margin). Management expects a sharp H2 margin recovery and reiterated a full-year FY27 EBITDA margin of 17% and mid-teens revenue growth.

financial_highlights.change: EBITDA +12.5% YoY; margin down about 50 bps
Double-digit growth in Q1 and Q2

segments.name: Trade distribution
segments.commentary: Grew about 14% in the quarter; management expects roughly 15% to sustain. Seasonality has shifted slightly later.

segments.name: D2C online
segments.commentary: Grew 22%; combined quick commerce and brand website contribution to D2C online revenue doubled YoY. Brand.com ASP is said to be 8-10% above marketplace.

segments.name: D2C offline / retail
segments.commentary: D2C offline grew 13%; management says like-to-like COCO grew about 20%, with franchise model transition (about 50 stores converted in Q2) depressing reported EBO growth to about 11-13%.

segments.name: Women and Kids
segments.commentary: Women grew 27% and Kids 34% in H1 FY27; their revenue share rose from 21.7% to about 22.7%.

segments.name: Premium (Rs 2,000+) products
segments.commentary: Volume grew above 50% YoY; share of volume rose from about 9% to 13%. Premium contributed Rs 12-13 of the approx Rs 40 ASP increase.

segments.name: New categories (ELAN, Apparel, Performance)
segments.commentary: Apparel: over 20,000 units sold in 5-6 months, mainly retail. ELAN: target over 100,000 units this fiscal year. Performance (badminton) launched about 60 days ago online, about 3,000 units in last 30 days; cricket line due January.

guidance_outlook: Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin of 17% reiterated; management says this does not depend on raw material prices easing.
Expects meaningful profitability recovery in H2 FY27 from pricing actions, mix, operating leverage and cost discipline.
Mid-teens revenue growth guided for FY27; management says it will not pursue revenue at the expense of profitability.
Input cost pressure may ease from around January if crude stays lower, per management; further price hikes depend on crude.
FY28 framed as the year to convert growth into accelerated earnings and better profitability.
Retail store size moving to 800-900 sq ft from 600-700 sq ft; a new Roop Nagar (Delhi) store format launched.
capex_capacity: Franchise model transition is 100% complete; about 50 stores converted in Q2 FY27.
Store formats now include Apparel and ELAN sections; Performance section to follow once the category scales.
ELAN 2.0 range launching in retail next month; cricket line launching January 2027.
Working capital days rose in Q2 due to planned inventory build for the Q3 season.
demand_pricing: Premium (Rs 2,000+) volume share rose from about 9% to 13%; management would not give a forward share target.
Price increases were calibrated; management prioritises absolute input cost recovery and consumer value over percentage margin protection.
Festive season: no GST change this year (last year had a GST change and a festive push); like-to-like D2C growing double digits.
Quick commerce portfolio is limited: Zepto about 8-9 products; Blinkit about 3 shoes added in last 2.5-3 months.
Management says peers (for example Asian) guiding about 25% growth; Campus remains at mid-teens.

qa_highlights.question: Size of kids and performance wear market and target share?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called these nascent, blue-ocean segments with few organised players; performance launched with badminton, with cricket and running next. No market size or share target was given.

qa_highlights.question: Medium-term growth outlook given peer guidance of about 25%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated mid-teens growth for FY27 and said it will go aggressive only where categories are profitable.

qa_highlights.question: Channel growth: trade vs EBO and sustainability of 15% trade growth?
qa_highlights.answer: EBO growth reflects the franchise model transition, with LFL COCO about 20%; retail growth is expected to reach 20%+ in upcoming quarters. Trade growth expected to stay in the 15% range.

qa_highlights.question: ASP bifurcation between premiumisation and price hikes?
qa_highlights.answer: ASP up about Rs 40 in absolute terms: Rs 12-13 from Rs 2,000+ premium products, the rest from mix and MRP increases that offset raw material inflation.

qa_highlights.question: Contribution of new categories to H1 topline?
qa_highlights.answer: New categories are small but growing: 20,000+ apparel units, 100,000+ ELAN units targeted for FY27; management says they are doubling down and will become sub-BUs.

qa_highlights.question: Promoter stake sale chatter?
qa_highlights.answer: Nikhil Aggarwal said there is no plan from the promoter family to sell in the foreseeable future.

qa_highlights.question: Nature and recovery timeline of Rs 125 crore government receivable in other current assets?
qa_highlights.answer: Mainly GST input credit, mostly from services; refunds being claimed from HP and UK (about Rs 25 crore soon) and Haryana (Rs 40 crore). Management expects 12-18 months to unlock it, with a big chunk after March once inventory falls; no further accumulation expected.

qa_highlights.question: H2 margin confidence given H1 EBITDA margin about 15%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited strong seasonal H2 history and operating leverage; the 17% guidance is said to hold regardless of raw material prices.

risks_watch: Gross margin pressure from material inflation (51.4% vs 53.9%); H2 margin recovery to 17% EBITDA depends on pricing lag unwinding.
Further price hikes possible if crude rises again; management says volume is being protected over margin.
About Rs 125 crore GST input credit receivable; recovery expected over 12-18 months and depends on inventory reduction and state refunds.
Working capital days elevated due to inventory build for Q3 season.
New categories (Performance, ELAN, Apparel) are still small; execution and channel exclusivity to be tracked.
Franchise model transition effects on reported EBO growth; the company expects retail growth to improve in upcoming quarters.
A dropped call during the Q&A limited one analyst's follow-up.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and the H2 margin recovery, but cautious on near-term profitability; management openly acknowledged input cost pressure and gave hedged answers on price hikes and input cost easing. It was evasive on quantifying new-category contribution and the forward premium share.
key_quotes: We remain confident on delivering a full year FY'27 EBITDA margin of 17%.
It is important to distinguish between recovering absolute input costs and protecting a percentage margin.
We are not depending on the 17% guidance with respect to the raw material coming down.
We will not run any business for driving revenue without it adding to our bottom line.

adds.what: Retail store franchise transition: about 50 stores converted in Q2 FY27 (not new capacity, ownership model change)
Retail store size moving to 800-900 sq ft from 600-700 sq ft; new Roop Nagar (Delhi) store format launched
ELAN 2.0 range launching in retail next month; cricket performance line launching January 2027

growth.why: Management guides mid-teens FY27 revenue growth (brief says cut, though the call quote only reiterates mid-teens) and a 17% full-year EBITDA margin held, backed by 6% ASP gains, premium volume growth above 50%, 10.2% volume growth and new categories, but no specific capacity or order numbers were given and margin recovery depends on pricing, mix and crude.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management reiterated 17% FY27 EBITDA margin versus 13.5% in Q2 and about 15% in H1, citing pricing, premium mix (Rs 12-13 of the ~Rs 40 ASP gain) and operating leverage, though gross margin fell to 51.4% from 53.9%.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Volume grew 10.2% in Q2 with H1 about 11%, trade distribution guided to about 15%, and retail expected to reach 20%+ as the franchise transition settles.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No capex or capacity plans were discussed, and the call cites no utilisation level; the only spend is inventory build and store format changes.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management held mid-teens revenue growth and 17% margin, and said it will not chase revenue at the expense of profitability, so no raise is signalled.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA margin was 13.5% and H1 about 15% against a 17% full-year target, and gross margin fell 250 bps to 51.4% with crude-linked inflation unresolved.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: ELAN 2.0 launches in retail next month, cricket performance line in January 2027, and ELAN targets over 100,000 units this fiscal year.

rows.label: Input cost relief and price actions
rows.why: Management says input cost pressure may ease from around January if crude stays lower, but further price hikes depend on crude, so the H2 recovery is conditional.

rows.label: Rs 125 crore GST receivable unlock
rows.why: About Rs 125 crore sits in other current assets, with about Rs 25 crore from HP/UK and Rs 40 crore from Haryana refunds; management expects a large part to unlock after March as inventory falls.

rows.label: Premium and women/kids categories scaling
rows.why: Premium Rs 2,000+ volume grew above 50% with share up from 9% to 13%, Women grew 27% and Kids 34% in H1, and D2C online grew 22%.

tone.note: Management was confident on mid-teens growth, the 17% FY27 margin and the H2 recovery from pricing and mix, but cautious on near-term margin and hedged on price hikes, crude and new-category contribution; analysts pressed on the margin bridge, the GST receivable and peer growth of about 25%.
